learning.learning_goal: Count and make groups from 16 through 20 again.
assumed_prior_knowledge: Previously met and counted numbers 16 through 20.
novice_success_criteria: Count each dot once in a changed arrangement.
Make a requested number of dots.

screens.title: Practice 16–20.
screens.body: Count the dots. Then make your own. You can take a break.
screens.audio: Count the dots. Then make your own. You can take a break.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count the dots. Tap the number that shows how many dots there are.

choices.feedback: Count every dot once. Check for a dot you missed or counted twice.
Count every dot once. Check for a dot you missed or counted twice.

hints: Start at the left. Touch each dot as you count.
Count each dot once. Then tap the number you reached.

screens.title: Make 16 dots.
screens.audio: Make sixteen dots. Add dots, then check.
screens.tooFewFeedback: You need 16 dots. Add a dot, then count again.
hints: Count as you add dots.
Stop at 16.
screens.tooManyFeedback: You need 16 dots. Remove a dot, then count again.
